_comment: Per-repo base branch + local-CI command profiles for /ship-dag's engine-invocation path (SKILL.md step 4). emit-config.mjs turns the resolved profile for each ready-wave repo into the config's repos: map (baseBranch + postSessionCheck). Keys are owner/repo. An entry's commands override the repo's own executable scripts/ci (scripts/ci-profile.mjs resolves both; a repo can drop its entry once it commits scripts/ci). baseBranch defaults to main for an entry without one, and to the repo's default branch when the repo is absent here; a repo with neither commands here nor scripts/ci gets no post-session check (emit-config warns). Keep commands aligned with each repo's own CI (its CLAUDE.md / workflow); they run through a shell from the worktree root, so a `cd <subdir> && …` prefix and shell constructs are fine. An entry may also set `host` (a key of the host registry, ~/.config/ship-dag/hosts.json, that runs the repo's issues under emit-config --by-host; default local) and `toolchains` (node/python/xcode, which win over what the commands imply). An entry may also declare `localLint: {command, forbid}`: the command an implement session runs for the lint step of its local CI, and the commands it must never run (a whole-repo lint that exhausts the machine); emit-config appends that rule to each of the repo's issue descriptions, and the command must be the lint in the entry's own commands. Set baseBranch explicitly for a repo whose default branch is not main (e.g. an iOS repo on master).

commands: uv run --no-sync pytest -m 'not pg and not external_api' -q
pytest -m 'not pg and not external_api and not stack and not slow' -q
NODE_ENV=test DB_HOST=localhost DB_NAME=dummy DB_USERNAME=dummy DB_PASSWORD=dummy npm run check:audit-coverage:ci
WXYC/Backend-Service._note: npm test is the INTEGRATION suite: it dotenvx-runs jest against a live stack (wait-on localhost:8080/8082 healthchecks) and times out in a bare engine worktree (ship-dag-bs1990-1991-20260807 wave-1 lesson, 2026-08-07). Engine checks stay stack-free (test:unit); the merge queue runs `npm run ci:testmock` (Docker) per PR before merging. CI lint-and-typecheck also runs prettier --check (format:check) — added 2026-08-08 after PR#2041 caught it in CI only. Lint is `npm run lint:changed` (BS#3556), not the 12 GB whole-repo `npm run lint`, which runs in CI; a missing script must fail loudly, so no --if-present. Still CI-only on purpose: the Type check: jobs, `npm run lint:migrations` and `npm run build`.
WXYC/Backend-Service._note2: The seven checks after audit-coverage run bare in .github/workflows/test.yml (three also have npm aliases, but CI calls all seven bare). A `npm run`-only sweep reports false green and the failure only appears in billed CI (BS#2591, 2026-09-18: check-bulk-update-analyze --strict exited 1 after five npm scripts passed). They are cheap static checks, so they run before the unit suite to fail fast. typecheck:tests and check:audit-coverage:ci (with the dummy DB_* env and NODE_ENV=test, CI's bare-tsx form rather than the pre-push hook's dotenvx one) match the npm scripts behind the lint-and-typecheck steps 'Type check tests (BS#3509)' and 'Account-audit route coverage (BS#2537)' in test.yml: tests/tsconfig.json is strict:false and catches errors the root typecheck never sees (BS#3453, BS#3455 passed the engine and failed there), and audit-coverage must follow typecheck because lint:prebuild builds the dists it imports. check:better-auth-mock-sync and check:db-mock-sync run in the session's push through the pre-push hook, and in CI's lint-and-typecheck job.

commands: for i in 1 2 3; do rm -rf node_modules 2>/dev/null && break; done; npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline
WXYC/dj-site._note: macOS re-creates .DS_Store inside node_modules subdirs while a delete walks them. npm ci removes a package's known files then rmdir's the dir, so a fresh .DS_Store makes that rmdir fail ENOTEMPTY and takes the whole check down (observed on node_modules/date-fns; prqueue-20260831 waves 2 and 3, at --parallel 4 and --parallel 1 alike, so it is not install contention). A single rm -rf can lose the same race (observed leaving only node_modules/{,next/,next/dist/}.DS_Store); the bounded retry wins it.

Static export (`output: 'export'`, Pages Router) — no SSR, no API routes, no getServerSideProps.

WXYC/wxyc-fastapi._note: Updated 2026-10-19: replaced `uv sync --extra dev` / `uv run --no-sync` with a venv plus `uv pip install`, because `uv sync` writes a uv.lock into this pip-based repo (which has no lockfile) and an implementer committed that file in WXYC/wxyc-fastapi PR #50. The new commands write no lockfile and mirror CI's `pip install -e '.[dev,posthog]'`. Verified 2026-10-19 in a fresh clone: ruff check + format clean, 298 pytest passed, and `git status --porcelain` empty afterward (.venv is gitignored). Earlier verification 2026-08-10 (191 passed). Mirrors .github/workflows/ci.yml, which runs `ruff check/format --check src tests scripts` and `pytest -v`. No mypy — this repo's CI does not run it (unlike library-metadata-lookup).
WXYC/wxyc-fastapi._deploy_note: Publishes to PyPI via tag-pushed Trusted Publishing (publish.yml), so a merge here is not itself a release — but a version bump + `v*` tag is. Consumers (library-metadata-lookup, request-o-matic, semantic-index) pin the package, so a merge does NOT reach them until published AND their pin is bumped: treat any downstream issue as a cross-repo cutover (SKILL.md step 7 / HITL point C), not an auto-release.

commands: TEST_RUNNER_WXYC_SKIP_KNOWN_FLAKES=1 TEST_RUNNER_WXYC_SKIP_SLOW=1 TEST_RUNNER_WXYC_SKIP_UI=1 scripts/test-affected.sh > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ship-dag-ci-$$.log" 2>&1 || { tail -120 "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ship-dag-ci-$$.log"; exit 1; }
WXYC/wxyc-ios-64._note: Updated 2026-08-27 (second revision, after master commit 1e49b2626). (1) DO NOT PASS --simulator. As of 1e49b2626 (PR #1020) scripts/test-affected.sh resolves the destination at run time via scripts/lib/simulator.zsh, and the repo CLAUDE.md now states the rule outright: never hardcode a simulator name or UUID, because both are local to one machine and one Xcode version and a stale one fails minutes into a build with 'Unable to find a device matching the provided destination specifier', which reads like a broken script. This field rotted twice before the run-time fix landed ('iPhone 15', then 'iPhone 17'). Passing --simulator now re-introduces the constant-with-an-expiry-date the script exists to remove. NOTE: a branch based BEFORE 1e49b2626 still has the hardcoded default and needs an explicit --simulator until it is rebased. (2) Shared/Wallpaper is a git submodule that a fresh worktree leaves uninitialized - xcodebuild dies at package resolution without the init. (3) The three TEST_RUNNER_ vars are MANDATORY. They mirror .github/workflows/build-and-test.yml, and without WXYC_SKIP_KNOWN_FLAKES the AppServicesTests/WidgetStateServiceRelevanceTests suite HANGS FOREVER at ~150% CPU (its mock spins on `while count < n { await Task.yield() }`, and Swift Testing's .timeLimit cannot cancel it) - it burns the whole stallTimeout instead of failing. xcodebuild strips the TEST_RUNNER_ prefix when forwarding into the runner; the shell-prefix form is required, a positional form after -destination silently does not propagate. (4) test-affected.sh hardcodes -resultBundlePath TestResults.xcresult and xcodebuild refuses to overwrite one. (5) RUN THIS REPO'S WAVES WITH --parallel 1: test-affected.sh exposes no -derivedDataPath flag, so concurrent worktrees building the same scheme share DerivedData and cross-contaminate. (6) Redirect output to a file. The engine runs these through spawnSync, whose default maxBuffer a full run overruns - a 2026-08-27 wave produced ~695KB and every issue failed with `spawnSync /bin/sh ENOBUFS` AFTER its PR was opened, which reads like a test failure and is not one. ENOBUFS is deterministic, so the built-in retry re-hits it identically. (7) `toolchains` is declared because split-by-host infers a toolchain from the command text, and `scripts/test-affected.sh` hides its xcodebuild calls, so without the declaration the profile infers none and an issue routed to a remote host would stay local with a warning. No node: the script and scripts/lib/simulator.zsh need only Xcode and git. A remote host needs the xcode toolchain in its hosts.json entry (host-run runs an Xcode wave one session at a time).

commands: SIM_ID=$(xcrun simctl list devices available | grep -m1 'iPhone 1[67]' | grep -oE '\([A-F0-9-]{36}\)' | tr -d '()'); test -n "$SIM_ID" || { echo 'no iPhone 16/17 simulator available' >&2; exit 1; }; xcrun simctl boot "$SIM_ID" 2>/dev/null; xcodebuild test -project WXYCDJ.xcodeproj -scheme WXYCDJ -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=$SIM_ID" -configuration Debug -skip-testing:WXYCDJTests/SpotlightClientStateToleranceTests -skip-testing:WXYCDJTests/SpotlightFieldResolutionTests CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
WXYC/wxyc-dj-ios._note: Added 2026-08-24 (sd-swiftauth run). Mirrors the repo CLAUDE.md pre-flight and .github/workflows/ci.yml: host swift test for the WXYCAPI package, then the app-target bundle on a simulator with the two device-only Spotlight suites skipped and code signing off. The sim pick tolerates a shutdown device (simctl boot is a no-op-ish when already booted; xcodebuild boots it otherwise). If project.yml or the source file list changed, the implementer must run `xcodegen generate` and commit the regenerated pbxproj BEFORE these commands — xcodebuild builds the checked-in project, not project.yml. A third check, scripts/verify-api-types.sh, applies ONLY when Packages/WXYCAPIModels/** or scripts/*-api-types.sh changed (needs git/npm/java/rsync). RUN THIS REPO'S WAVES WITH --parallel 1 (verified 2026-08-30): the sim pick is `grep -m1 'iPhone 1[67]'`, so every concurrent worktree resolves the SAME device, and two xcodebuild runs then install the same bundle id (org.wxyc.dj) plus its XCTest runner onto it at once — the second install overwrites the first mid-test. Unlike wxyc-ios-64 this is NOT a DerivedData problem (Xcode hashes DerivedData on the project's full path, so per-worktree paths already separate), it is simulator contention, and it surfaces as a flaky app-target failure that reads like a real one. Making waves parallel here needs a per-worktree `simctl clone`, not a different grep.

cd backend || exit 1; db="ts_$(basename "$(cd .. && pwd)" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | tr -c 'a-z0-9' '_' | cut -c1-40)_test"; DATABASE_URL_TEST="${DATABASE_URL_TEST:-postgresql+asyncpg://postgres:postgres@localhost:55432/$db}" ./.venv/bin/pytest -q
WXYC/triangle-shows._note: Fork has no PR-triggered CI; deploy.yml runs only the frontend node tests on push to main, so backend pytest is a local-only gate (2026-08-08). Backend needs a real PostgreSQL: the conftest default targets :5432, but on this machine :5432 is a local PG holding real discogs/musicbrainz data and the harness does create_all/drop_all — so DATABASE_URL_TEST points at a throwaway container instead (`docker run -d --rm --name ts-test-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -p 55432:5432 postgres:16-alpine`), per backend/README.md:92. Venv must be python3.13 or older: psycopg2 has no 3.14 wheel. The database name is derived PER WORKTREE: the harness does create_all/drop_all per test, so two ship-dag sessions sharing one database name shred each other's schema mid-run — that produced 2-of-5 red runs with DBAPI/ProgrammingError noise during the #88/#90 wave (2026-08-08) and reads as container flakiness if you only ever run one at a time. Name must keep a `test` component to satisfy conftest's safety rail.

daisysguide/ios._note: Added 2026-09-06 (beta ship-DAG run; plan: daisyguide docs/plans/2026-09-06-beta-ship-dag.md, section 0.5 step 3). Mirrors ios/scripts/ci.sh with three divergences: (1) no sudo xcode-select pin - inert on that machine (only /Applications/Xcode.app exists, the Xcode_*.app glob matches nothing, ci.sh takes its fallback branch), real the day a versioned Xcode is installed; (2) plain `xcodegen generate` vs ci.sh's --use-cache branch - inert in an always-fresh worktree (no pbxproj to be stale); (3) -derivedDataPath DerivedData plus the trailing rm - ci.sh passes/does neither. The -derivedDataPath pins what is otherwise only the machine-global IDECustomDerivedDataLocation Xcode pref; the rm is a disk budget for halted-path runs where worktrees persist (mergePolicy none + halted merge queue), at the cost of a cold rebuild per review-fix iteration - judge whether it still earns that tax before reusing. The redirect is MANDATORY: a full suite log blows execSync's 1 MiB default maxBuffer and every node dies ENOBUFS after opening its PR (same lesson as WXYC/wxyc-ios-64). resolve-sim-udid.py gives each worktree its own simulator; NEVER hand-create devices, and never `git worktree remove` while any node runs - the resolver's orphan reaper fires twice per node here; export DGS_NO_REAP=1 for the run as the backstop and unset it after. The eight python guards are the repo's pre-Xcode checks (test.yml); milliseconds each. 2026-09-06 addendum: the resolve-sim-udid guard suite runs with `env -u DGS_NO_REAP` because the run exports DGS_NO_REAP=1 for the resolver invocations inside the xcodebuild entries, and the suite pins default-reaper behavior from ambient env — with the var set, 1 of its 79 tests fails and the whole check dies at command 2. The final rm retries once after 5s: an SPM writer can repopulate SourcePackages between readdir and rmdir, failing an otherwise-green check at the cleanup step.

WXYC/wxyc-dj-android._note: Mirrors .github/workflows/ci.yml exactly. :api:test is named separately from the :app tasks on purpose: :api is a pure JVM module and its suites are the repo's whole structural bet, so they must never be able to stop running as a side effect of a task-graph change. ANDROID_HOME is exported because a fresh worktree has no local.properties (gitignored) and AGP would otherwise fail with 'SDK location not found'; verified 2026-08-19 that the env fallback builds clean without it. Lint runs abortOnError against an empty baseline.

WXYC/wallpaper-ios._note: Verified green 2026-09-15 in a clean detached worktree: build 44s, 340 tests in 67 suites, both exit 0 (the suite had grown to 351 tests in 68 suites by 2026-10-12). Engine worktrees land beside the checkout as Shared/Wallpaper--<slug> (scripts/engine/repo-layout.mjs). `xcrun` is load-bearing — swiftly puts Swift 6.2 first on PATH (~/.swiftly/bin/swift) while the SDK is Xcode 27's, and bare `swift build` dies with 'unknown argument: -target-arch-variant' before compiling anything. xcrun selects the Xcode toolchain (6.4) and the mismatch disappears. This repo is a SUBMODULE of WXYC/wxyc-ios-64 (Shared/Wallpaper), and its Package.swift takes six `../` path dependencies (Analytics, Caching, ColorPalette, Core, Logger, WXUI). They resolve only because PROJECT_ROOT derives to .../wxyc-ios-64/Shared, which is where those siblings live — so worktrees MUST land under Shared/. The package's own CLAUDE.md says swift build cannot resolve from a standalone clone; that is true of a bare clone and NOT of a worktree in the submodule layout. `swift test` never compiles .metal, so shader changes need the sample app (Examples/WallpaperSampleApp) by hand. The repo has no GitHub Actions CI of its own — this profile is the only automated check, so do not weaken it.
